item.title: From Map Tiles To Trail Masks
item.author: connor@loughondata.com (Connor Lough)
item.description: A checkpoint from learning geospatial computer vision from first principles: map tiles, weak OSM labels, raster masks, PyTorch tensors, and why the first model failed in a useful way.
